mentions.name: Resume-to-JD Tailoring Script
mentions.description: A simple Python script that uses OpenAI's API to fit a resume to a job description, helping a recent MBA graduate apply to AI product and marketing roles more easily while also learning how the technology works and its limitations.
mentions.problem: The job market is brutal — despite many applications the sister hasn't received an offer, and tailoring a resume to each job description by hand is difficult.
mentions.source_excerpt: Helping my recent MBA grad sister make a simple python script to fit here resume to a JD using openAI's api.
